visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video begins with a close-up of a star-shaped pizza on a black slate board. A person's hand, wearing a black sleeve, uses a large chef's knife to cut the pizza into slices. The background shows a soft-lit indoor setting near a window with a potted plant. (2) A hand lifts a slice of the pizza, showing a golden-brown crust and melted cheese topping. The camera stays focused on the food. (3) The scene shifts to a preparation montage on a white marble surface. A round dough is placed on a black baking tray, sprinkled with flour, and cut into six radial segments using a white scraper. (4) The creator adds dollops of orange-red sauce and a mixture of shredded cheese and corn to each segment. (5) Hands are seen folding the edges of the dough segments inwards to create the points of a star shape. (6) The center of the star is then filled with more sauce, pieces of ham cut with scissors, a thin slice of tomato, and a final topping of shredded cheese. (7) The tray is placed inside a white, retro-styled electric oven. A hand turns the knobs to set the temperature to 280 degrees and the time to 9 minutes. The pizza is seen baking and bubbling through the oven window. (8) The finished pizza is removed from the oven. Olive oil is drizzled over the top from a bottle, and fresh green parsley leaves are hand-placed as a garnish. (9) The final phase shows the pizza being sliced again and a piece lifted to the camera, displaying the crispy bottom and the steaming, cheesy interior.

(3) A series of quick 'pop' SFX play in rhythm with the dough-cutting and ingredient-placing montage. The mix is clean and focuses on these percussive design elements. narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video serves as a creative culinary demonstration, showing viewers how to transform simple pizza ingredients into a unique 'starfish' shape. It emphasizes the ease of the process and the appetizing final results to inspire home cooking.
